headline: Empowering Communities, Transforming Generations
subheadline: Purpose-driven social investment rooted in human dignity, education, and health.
description: Through the Arvion Foundation, our philanthropic initiatives partner directly with grassroots village councils, government schools, and rural primary health centers to deliver sustainable, measurable social change.

pillars.title: Girls in STEM & Digital Classrooms
pillars.summary: Equipping rural higher-secondary schools with modern robotics and coding labs, coupled with full academic scholarships for young women pursuing engineering degrees.
programs: Arvion Pragati STEM scholarships covering 100% of engineering tuition
Smart interactive digital classrooms installed in 120 rural schools
Teacher training and science pedagogy modernization programs

pillars.title: Maternal Health & Preventive Care Vans
pillars.summary: Operating mobile diagnostic medical clinics delivering prenatal ultrasound screenings, pediatric malnutrition management, and vision care to doorstep communities.
programs: Fleet of 8 fully-equipped mobile medical vans with diagnostic tele-links
Nutritional support hampers for expectant mothers in high-risk talukas
Preventive diabetes and hypertension screening camps

pillars.title: Artisanal Skilling & Women's Cooperatives
pillars.summary: Preserving traditional handloom weaving and natural dyeing techniques while providing micro-credit and supply chain linkages directly to global handicraft markets.
programs: Heritage Handloom Craft Guild supporting indigenous weaver families
Financial literacy and micro-enterprise management workshops
Guaranteed buy-back agreements for artisanal Khadi and embroidered goods
